name: Nokia E7-00

images.credit: Petr Zdražil, CC BY 3.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Launch.Predecessor: Nokia E75, Nokia E90 Communicator, Nokia N97

Network.Technology: HSDPA (Pentaband) (3.5G) 850 / 900 / 1700 / 1900 / 2100, Quad band GSM / GPRS / EDGE GSM 850, GSM 900, GSM 1800, GSM 1900

Platform.Operating system: Symbian^3, upgradeable to Nokia Belle Refresh (111.040.1511)

Memory.Storage: 16 GB external mass storage, 256 MB RAM, 1 GB ROM

Cameras.Rear camera: 8 Megapixels (main), 16:9 720p video, 35 FPS. Dual LED flash (can be used as flashlight by holding the Lock key).

Battery.Battery: BL-4D (1200mAh) Li-Ion battery (removable by service), micro-USB charging
